audience: marketing and lifecycle teams that send customer email and track events with Vero

useCases.title: Create or update a customer profile
useCases.text: Create a customer profile, or update its properties. Set update_only to change existing profiles only.

useCases.title: Track a customer event
useCases.text: Record an event for a customer, such as a page view or a purchase. Event data values must be strings.

useCases.title: Add or remove segment tags
useCases.text: Add tags to a customer profile, or remove tags. Tags group customers for segments and campaigns.

useCases.title: Stop email when a customer asks
useCases.text: Unsubscribe one customer from all Vero email when the customer asks to stop receiving email.
